name: ModifyMasterSpec

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For information about how to obtain the resource group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例当前所属的资源组ID。如何获取资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The master resources. Valid values: 
2 CU 
4 CU 
8 CU 
16 CU 
32 CU 
Master resources greater than 8 CU incur additional fees
parameters.help_zh:
Master资源，取值如下： 
2 CU 
4 CU 
8 CU 
16 CU 
32 CU 
8CU以上的master资源会产生费用
parameters.name: master_cu

parameters.help_en:
If you want to change the master node to a MasterAI node, specify this parameter.

This parameter and MasterCU cannot be specified at the same time.
Only specific regions and zones support changing the master node to a MasterAI node.
Only AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 Basic Edition instances support MasterAI nodes.
You can view all valid values of this parameter on the specification change page for the master node
parameters.help_zh:
如果您需要将Master节点变更为MasterAI节点，请指定该参数。

该参数与MasterCU不能同时指定。
仅部分地域和可用区均支持将Master节点变更为MasterAI节点。
仅AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0版的基础版实例支持MasterAI节点。
您可以在Master节点变配的售卖页面上查询该参数的所有可能取值
parameters.name: master_ai_spec

parameters.help_en:
The effective period of the specification change. Valid values: 
Immediately (default): The change takes effect immediately.
MaintainTime: The change takes effect during the maintenance window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
变更配置的生效时间，取值说明： 
Immediately（默认值）：立即生效。
MaintainTime：实例可运维时间段内生效。
parameters.name: effective_time
